escenas.descripcion: A vibrant fig tree sprouting fresh green leaves in a sunny Galilean countryside setting.
Jesus standing outdoors surrounded by his disciples, gently teaching them with outstretched arms under warm daylight.
Jesus extending his hand with tenderness against a serene landscape under a radiant golden sky.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
texto_evangelio: At that time, he told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees. When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near. Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near. Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished. Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.”

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Luke.
At that time, he told them a parable.
“See the fig tree and all the trees. When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near. Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.”
Even if everything around you changes and seems unstable, the Lord's promise always remains, so trust in his steadfast love. Where are you resting your heart today?

frase_es: El cielo y la tierra pasarán, pero mis palabras no pasarán.
reflexion_es: Aunque todo a tu alrededor cambie y parezca inestable, la promesa del Señor permanece siempre. Confía en su amor firme. ¿Dónde apoyas hoy tu corazón?
